blocks.text: We listen to customer feedback and fine-tune every detail to ensure our clothes are more comfortable, higher quality, and longer lasting—at affordable prices for the whole family.

items.label: COMFORT AND FIT
items.value: This soft bucket bag has an adjustable removable cross-body strap, is lightweight for comfort, and is the perfect size to fit your daily essentials.

items.label: MATERIAL
items.value: Amazon Essentials bags are made from high-quality alternative leather materials. This style has a pebbled faux leather body, webbing shoulder strap, and metal hardware.

items.label: STYLE
items.value: The adjustable and removable shoulder strap allows you to wear this bag across the body, on the shoulder, or on the arm. The hidden magnetic closure ensures your belongings are secured, internal pocket for organization and metal hardware gives a refined look.

items.label: DETAILS
items.value: 9.5 inches long at base, 12.5 inches long at top opening x 10.5 inches tall x 5.5 inches wide.

items.label: DESIGN
items.value: This bag is your perfect styling accessory for day or night.
